name: Pika H3 Flex [ref2va]
note: [Pika H3 Flex [ref2va]](https://huggingface.co/Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex) is Pika's six-step post-training of MiniMax H3 [ref2va] that generates video guided by reference subjects, objects, or scenes. Provide reference images through the canvas and moodboard, and identify them in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. At least one reference image is required. It generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 480- or 768-pixel short side, 6 LCM steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3.
